title: Drag Things
body:
![Title: Drag Things](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1db67f383d04715d31aa5677fe624d4ab0510882_0.webp)


~~-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------~~
##   Dragging is an iconic mechanic featured in many popular games like Roblox (Dead Rails, 99 Nights in the Forest, A Dusty Trip), Half-Life, and R.E.P.O. Despite its popularity, this immersive feature is still missing from Minecraft. If you've been looking for a way to bring this dynamic interaction to your world—this mod is for you!
~~-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------~~


![Feature](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0971572503d17998c6023eb634e7734521635430_0.webp)


~~-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------~~
### - You can easily drag items by holding Right Click, then move them around by moving your camera.
### - If you want to throw an item, just release Right Click while you are moving.
### - The physics are smooth and satisfying to play with.
### - It’s optimized so it won't lag your game.

~~-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------~~


![How to use](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c164ae9369855190e675fe023383ad9d6e46836_0.webp)
